title: Robonaut 2 prepared for launch on STS-133 (KSC, 2010-08-27)
contents: 18-180 s of the original, letterbox cropped to 600x338. Skips the opening with Star Wars costumed fans (third-party characters). R2 flexes its arms at ~93 s and waves at ~147 s. Contains NASA/GM logos on R2's chest (don't use as branding).
